title: Health Care Analytics Challenges: A 3-Pillar Framework Connecting Analytics Maturity, Workforce Agility, and Technical Enablement
description: Research repository for a Viewpoint paper proposing Human-in-the-Loop Knowledge Governance (HITL-KG), a socio-technical framework for mitigating institutional amnesia in healthcare analytics. Includes a Three-Pillar Assessment Rubric, validated query triple architecture, and a Python-based literature review tool implementing Clean Architecture for academic claim verification.
notes: Research repository for the Viewpoint paper proposing Human-in-the-Loop Knowledge Governance (HITL-KG) for mitigating institutional amnesia in health care analytics, together with the accompanying literature review toolset. The paper was accepted by the Interactive Journal of Medical Research on 2026-07-13 (ms#96541) and is scheduled for publication on 2026-08-21 as Interact J Med Res 2026;15:e96541, doi 10.2196/96541. This release corresponds to the accepted, copyedited manuscript. The version and publication date for each release are derived automatically from the corresponding GitHub release tag.
